input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Sparkling, which meets the preferred position. The licence grant in § 2 is expressly non-exclusive; the restrictions in § 3 are ordinary software use/copying limits and do not prevent Sparkling from procuring competing software, maintenance or other services from third parties; § 10 (Maintenance and Support) and § 11 (Fees) contain no requirement that Sparkling take support or updates only from Garman; and the only other "exclusive" references (exclusive remedy in § 15, non-exclusive escrow licence in § 16, non-exclusive jurisdiction in § 20(h)) are unrelated to exclusive dealing. Nothing restricts our freedom to buy from other suppliers, so no redline is needed.
